method: Pinned source catalogue: original static declarations retained with their implementation/evidence statuses; ordered built-in loader paths, legacy mapping mutations, entrypoints and inherited/mutated schemas reconciled as source candidates in companion JSON. Runtime import/finalization, dynamic parameter providers, model/encoder/VAE/widget variants and reference scenarios remain unqualified. Remote nodes remain excluded.

capabilities.name: Plain SD1 U-Net CPU Float32 inference
capabilities.limits: Actual four-channel full-topology U-Net with SD1 fixed-count heads and convolutional spatial projections; strict safetensors loading and retained weights. Unit/source tests use reduced-width synthetic parameters and CPU/F32 inference only. Stock-width forwards, pretrained weights, model-family compatibility, complete workflows, extensions, training and GPU qualification remain open.

capabilities.name: Plain SD2 U-Net CPU Float32 inference
capabilities.limits: Actual four-channel full-topology U-Net with SD2 fixed-size heads and linear spatial projections; strict safetensors loading and retained weights. Unit/source tests use reduced-width synthetic parameters and CPU/F32 inference only. This does not provide CLIP-H. Stock-width forwards, pretrained weights, model-family compatibility, complete workflows, extensions, training and GPU qualification remain open.

capabilities.name: Classical image VAE CPU Float32 inference
capabilities.limits: Actual classical encoder/decoder, middle attention and legacy quant/post-quant layers; deterministic unscaled mean latents and source image crop/range/view boundaries. Unit/source tests use reduced-width synthetic parameters and CPU/F32 inference only. Stock-width forwards, pretrained weights, model-family compatibility, complete workflows, tiling, training and GPU qualification remain open.

capabilities.name: SD discrete schedule and EPS/V diffusion boundaries
capabilities.limits: Default 1000-step discrete schedule with source F64 construction before F32 tables, timestep lookup/interpolation, explicit EPS/V conversion, noise scaling and separate latent-format scaling. CPU/F32 inference tests cover arithmetic boundaries; related graph scenarios use reduced-width synthetic parameters. Other schedules, complete sampler trajectories, pretrained workflows, model-family compatibility, training and GPU qualification remain open.

capabilities.name: SD whole-image CFG CPU Float32 inference
capabilities.limits: Whole-image guidance on denoised predictions with source scale-one omission, explicit separate calls and optional compatible context concatenation with separate fallback. Each policy has its own reduced-width synthetic CPU/F32 inference reference; numerical equivalence between policies is not assumed. Hardware-dependent batching, regions/masks, hooks/controls, pretrained workflows, model-family compatibility, training and GPU qualification remain open.

capabilities.name: StringFormat
capabilities.limits: Explicit python-format-text-v1 partial profile: named fields, escaped braces, Unicode text alignment/width/precision and !s; empty-format null/bool/Int64. Numeric/locale formatting, !r/!a, item/attribute access, nested fields, floating-point and formatted containers/native values are refused. Fixed a..z UI ports, eager mapping and existing execution_error diagnostics. Local Windows validation: 36 profile tests, 44 source boundary cases (24 exact-output, 12 source-error boundaries, 8 local profile refusals), 12 Host tests and compiler/editor coverage; actual Desktop/Host preview smoke passed. No full Python str.format, complete-workflow or platform qualification is claimed. See docs/qualification/string-format-integration.md and docs/STRING_FORMAT.md.

capabilities.name: CaseConverter
capabilities.limits: Valid Unicode scalar strings only, using CPython 3.12.10 casing tables and managed Upper/Lower/Capitalize/Title helpers. No NFC, casefold or locale conversion; isolated UTF-16 surrogates refused. V3 COMBO retains four exact choices and multiselect=false, with no source mode default. Unknown mode is refused by engine COMBO admission; direct valid-text body keeps the source identity fallback. Local full campaign passed 2225 tests, including 249 new cases: 28 node, 68 helper, 85 source digest plans, 40 source node cases, 4 engine argument-order regressions, 19 real Host, 3 Workflow and 2 Desktop tests. Source cases distinguish 28 comparable results, 8 typed errors versus engine STRING coercion and 4 direct identity fallbacks versus COMBO admission refusal. Three source repetitions and one C# pass per digest plan; no exhaustive string-context, complete-workflow or platform qualification. See docs/qualification/case-converter-integration.md and docs/CASE_CONVERTER.md.

capabilities.name: StringContains
capabilities.limits: Valid Unicode scalar text only; ordinal comparison after independent whole-string CPython 3.12.10 lowercase when case_sensitive=false. No normalization or casefold; isolated UTF-16 surrogates refused. V3 COMBO retains type, multiselect=false and options; legacy projection unchanged. Local Windows integration: 1976 unique tests passed, including 224 new cases (35 node behavior, 48 Unicode helper, 68 source lower digest plans, 40 source node cases partitioned 36 comparable/2 typed-body errors with distinct engine coercion/2 source-empty versus local COMBO admission refusals, 24 Host, 6 Workflow, 2 Desktop, 1 V3 projection regression). Comparable outputs comprise 39 Boolean values and 1 blocker. Actual compiled Desktop/Host smoke returned True and False. No complete-workflow or platform qualification claimed. See docs/qualification/text-comparison-integration.md and docs/TEXT_COMPARISON.md.

capabilities.name: CreateList
capabilities.limits: Top-level wildcard Autogrow.TemplatePrefix, inputs.input0 through inputs.input9, ordered execution-list concatenation and typed blocker propagation. Desktop provides ten fixed ports; automatic growth, shared MatchType propagation, nested dynamic templates and V3 lazy hooks remain open. See docs/CREATE_LIST.md for validation scope.
